key_provisions_or_claims: No one may train or examine for a Remote Pilot Certificate of Competency without a valid CAAM-issued RPTO Certificate of Approval (12-month validity, non-transferable).
RPTOs need accountable manager, safety manager, chief remote pilot, maintenance controller and instructors, plus a safety management system and emergency response plan.
Defines A2 RCoC, RCoC-B and EVLOS and agricultural modules, with a 75% pass mark and CAAM-run online exams.
UAS regulation is operation-centric, risk-based and performance-based (Open, Specific, Certified categories).
Requires third-party liability insurance, occurrence reporting within 48 hours, annual audits and a 5-year record retention.
annotation.summary_en: Civil Aviation Directive 6011 Part (I), issued by the Civil Aviation Authority of Malaysia under the Civil Aviation Act 1969. It sets the requirements for approving Remote Pilot Training Organisations. It covers certification, personnel, safety management, syllabi and exams for unmanned aircraft remote pilot competency certificates, within a risk-based Open/Specific/Certified framework.
